findings.detail: Credential secret values live only in the R9 brokerage SQLite store under the proving area; evidence records 64-hex fingerprints and [REDACTED] placeholders. The secret scan checks every R9-owned artifact plus full-body containment of known synthetic values.
findings.title: Brokerage store holds synthetic local secrets outside evidence

findings.detail: Canary git repositories create read-only object files on Windows; R9 temp clear chmods files writable before removal, confined to the R9 proving root.
findings.title: Windows read-only git objects require read-only-safe temp clear

findings.detail: Browser, communication, and calendar connectors have no real configured provider and network is disabled; they are recorded as NOT_TESTED/BLOCKED and do not block the files/git/services gates.
findings.title: Unavailable connectors are honestly NOT_TESTED/BLOCKED

findings.detail: Gate R9-G05 runs a fresh verifier subprocess with only file paths and no builder context; it reproduces lifecycle, real canary effect, and fail-closed paths. The final builder_status stays NOT_TESTED until a fresh independent verifier adjudicates the frozen package.
findings.title: Builder status remains NOT_TESTED until fresh independent adjudication

findings.detail: Cosmetic: R9_FULL_SUITE_RAW.txt and focused raw outputs may omit final 'N passed' lines; JUnit counts and exit codes are authoritative.
findings.title: Full-suite raw outputs omit pytest summary lines

findings.detail: The first before/after live guard window spanned the long full-suite run and observed transient protected Python workers exit (command hashes eff40..., 328d..., a52b...); the persistent protected command pair 824e... remained unchanged and r9_attributable_mutation was False. The guard was re-wrapped around the final closure window so protected_state_unchanged=True within the recorded window without weakening the comparison.
findings.title: Live daemon worker churn between wide-window live guard captures

findings.detail: The manifest's SELF_REFERENTIAL_REPORT entry captured the builder report size before the final report rewrite attached the manifest verification block, so it recorded 8076 while the on-disk report is 8195. build_evidence.py now rewrites the manifest after the final report write so the self-entry records the final on-disk report size. This was an S4 closure-ordering artifact with no effect on the 77-entry hash audit.
findings.title: Self-referential manifest entry recorded stale builder-report size
